sql: WITH a AS (SELECT r.year,r.round,re.* FROM results re JOIN races r USING(race_id) WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959), b AS (SELECT year,driver_id,MIN(round) f,MAX(round) l FROM a GROUP BY year,driver_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT round)>=2), ok AS (SELECT DISTINCT b.year,b.driver_id FROM b JOIN a x ON x.year=b.year AND x.driver_id=b.driver_id AND x.round=b.f JOIN a y ON y.year=b.year AND y.driver_id=b.driver_id AND y.round=b.l AND y.constructor_id=x.constructor_id) SELECT driver_id FROM ok WHERE driver_id NOT IN(501,554,579) GROUP BY driver_id HAVING COUNT(*)>0 ORDER BY driver_id
